name: SPEC-P-012: the tutorial's final release item is blocked by the voice plan's P-010 (and P-011)
summary: The probe queried harness_shared.work_item_deps (the table work_items:link writes blocking edges to) and found one 'blocks' edge papercusp#WI-10006883 -> papercusp#WI-10004839. WI-10006883 implements voice-two-tier-elevenlabs-agent-2026-10-06#P-010; WI-10004839 implements cloud-app-live-tutorial-2026-10-01#P-012, the tutorial's final end-to-end acceptance and production release. The same probe run on P-011's item also found its edge, and the negative control exited 1.
scope: Read-only query of the operator database on the dev host, run in host context (sudo -n -u postgres psql). Nothing was linked, unlinked or changed.
oracle: Independent of the code under test: the persisted dependency row itself, read straight from Postgres rather than through work_items:get, which did not surface blocking edges on build d740fc3802. The expected edge comes from the plan text (P-012: the tutorial release waits for this plan's P-010), not from the probe.

assertions.evidence: p012-probe blocker=papercusp#WI-10006876 blocked=papercusp#WI-10004839 edges=0 (exit 1). WI-10006876 is this plan's P-003, which blocks other plan items but not the tutorial release, so a pass is not vacuous.
